descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S13 Typed 'new admission' / 'new patient' / 'H&P' / 'consult' text through Save Note and Save & Extract never moves the badge up from Follow-up (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 The app never sets the status from dictation, in either direction (up to New Admission / Consult, or down to Follow-up): add-form dictation, pre-round Save Note, encounter Save & Extract, Quick Dicta … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 5)
  • U1 Nothing is ever New Admission (or Consult) unless the physician set it: the app never guesses the status, and a patient nobody has set reads Follow-up (UAT TC-06)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Session fixture, both patients untouched (Follow-up)

When Type the trigger texts into the pre-round editor and press Save Note, then into encounter notes and press Save & Extract; reload; repeat in Nursing Home

Then Badge stays Follow-up and the pre-selected template stays SOAP progress / SNF follow-up after every save and after the reload

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 'The app never sets status from dictation' + AC 5. Deterministic: one snapshot with New Admission or Consult selected is a Fail (no 3.2 allowance). Each typed text carries several trigger phrasings (Daniela's 2026-09-26 'new patient' / 'new admission' / 'admitted today', plus 'H&P', 'initial visit', 'consult'), so a path that reacts to any one of them is caught in on …

Where it ran: dev unit U33; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
